notes.title: Demo Update v0.2.0
notes.content: [olist][*][p]All levels in Chapter 2 have been redesigned, and a new mechanism has been introduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Some levels in Chapter 1 have been optimized for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][*][p]The visuals in Chapter 2 have been enhanced.[/p][/*][*][p]New sound effects have been added to enrich the gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]A new setting for control inversion has been added. You can now use W or ↑ to jump and S or ↓ to invert. These controls can be customized in the settings. Additionally, you can choose whether the controls should also invert after flipping. By default, they will not follow the inversion.[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.1.0
notes.content:
We've completely redesigned the levels - we added some new ones and removed some old ones. We made the game require more thinking while making some parts less about quick reflexes. We hope you'll enjoy playing this new version more.
Sorry about this, but because we changed so much, your old save files won't work anymore. The game will make new save files automatically. We'd love for you to try the game again from the start - we think you'll like the changes. Thanks so much for playing!

notes.title: Demo Update v0.0.4
notes.content:
1. Based on the feedback received, we have optimized the design of several levels that were difficult to understand.
2. We have added 8 new levels.

notes.title: Demo Update v0.0.2
notes.content:
1. Shortened character death animation duration.
2. Fixed an issue where characters could die abnormally under certain conditions.
3. The game now automatically adjusts to the current screen resolution upon first launch. Added 1280x720 resolution option. Fullscreen mode will be introduced in the official release.
4. Resolved a misalignment of the version number text on the main menu across different resolutions.
